caveats: Google Business Profile data (claim status, hours, categories, photos) could not be inspected directly; ratings and counts in this file come from third-party aggregators that state they mirror Google Maps data, and may differ from live Maps.
Scores compare businesses in this batch only (ten East Brunswick real-estate/property firms), not the industry.
No business in this batch uses consumer booking platforms (Booksy/Fresha/Vagaro etc.); 'bookable' was measured as the ability to request a quote, apply, or schedule online.
Winding River Realty's website gives a Milltown office address (440 South Main Street, Suite 5) while the batch lists 646 NJ-18, East Brunswick. I could not confirm which is current.
The batch URL for Strategic Home Solutions (strategichomesolutions.com) no longer resolves to the company; I reviewed their Buildium portal instead.
Anything described as an inference is labelled as such and is not stated by the business.
data_gaps: Calco Asset Management: could not confirm current operation, ownership, portfolio or Google Business Profile. calcomgt.com fails DNS and the only archived snapshot (Dec 2021) was an unfinished placeholder. Status 'operating' rests on directory records and a 2021 NJ EDA grant.
Lance Bram Commercial Brokerage: no Google rating or review count found on any directory I opened.

Kroll Commercial Realty: a site-wide reCAPTCHA script loads, but no CAPTCHA widget appeared in front of the contact form I inspected; behaviour on a real submission was not tested (no forms were submitted anywhere).

Two page titles returned by my browser session carried a leading emoji glyph that is absent from the raw HTML; I treated that as a tooling artifact, not a site defect.
